text:
Nina: Morning crew  tiny mystery: hummus tub in the fridge labeled 'NINA - DO NOT TOUCH' is down to maybe 1 spoonful. Who's the hummus bandit? :eyes:
Raj: Not me. Unless it was tzatziki in disguise?
Ben: Guilty of hummus curiosity last week but I left a note. If it's gone I owe you a new one.
Eliza: I confess to stirring hummus to check for olives. I will replace + throw in pita. Sorry!
Nina: Thank you Eliza  appreciate the pita add. Also small PSA: the electric kettle keeps switching off mid-boil. Check before you leave it.
Raj: That's the Kettle A(pril) issue again. I left a troubleshooting sticky on the kettle last month. Steps: 1) empty scale tray, 2) reset switch behind handle, 3) run 2 cycles.
Ben: can we add a 'kettle calibration' line to the kitchen rota? I'm the resident tea saboteur, happy to own it this week.
Eliza: vote: bagels or croissants for tomorrow snack run? Reply with emoji: :bagel: bagels, :croissant: croissants
Nina: :bagel:
Raj: :bagel:
Ben: :croissant: (sacrificial croissant martyr here)
Eliza: Planned run: I can swing by the bakery at 9:30. Need anything else?
Nina: oat milk and napkins please. Also small ask: anyone using the small fridge shelf for meal prep, put a name and date on it. We keep getting unclaimed tupperwares.
snackbot: Reminder: Kitchen rota posted. This week's kitchen guardian: Ben. Please do a quick sweep Friday.
Ben: noted. I'll do a clearout Friday 11am. If you want to rescue anything, speak now or forever hold your leftover lasagna.
Eliza: Bought hummus + pita + oat milk. Left receipt on top of microwave. Venmo @eliza-bakery for $7.20. Photo: <https://imgur.com/fakebakery987> :yum:
Nina: Legend. Ill label the replaced hummus with a sticker that says 'Nina - you owe me olives' :laughing:
Raj: Also thanks Ben for volunteering kettle duty. Il leave the sticky with the three-step fix on the kettle for posterity.
Ben: happy to help. Reminder to everyone: label, check, and when in doubt, ask. Peace and pastries.
